tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: The open C of the GPUI Kit mark. Used only in the logo.

tokens.name: mark-accent
tokens.usage: The bar-and-stem that turns the C into a G. The only saturated colour of the brand; in UI it appears only as data (`chart-2`).

tokens.name: accent-background
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted rows in menus, lists and ghost Buttons.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Main window and content surface. Ground for `foreground` text.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions and the outline of cards, tables and separators.

tokens.name: group_box-background
tokens.usage: GroupBox fill: a grouped settings section on `background`.

tokens.name: caret
tokens.usage: Text caret in inputs and editors.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (blue scale, light to dark). Data only, never decoration.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (blue scale, light to dark). Data only, never decoration.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (blue scale, light to dark). Data only, never decoration.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (blue scale, light to dark). Data only, never decoration.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (blue scale, light to dark). Data only, never decoration.

tokens.name: danger-background
tokens.usage: Danger Button, destructive badges and error states. Destructive meaning only.

tokens.name: danger-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-background`. Below 4.5:1 on `danger-background` in both themes (3.6:1 light, 1.8:1 dark): components set danger text as `danger-background` on a tint instead.

tokens.name: drag_border
tokens.usage: Insertion line while dragging tabs, rows or panels.

tokens.name: drop_target-background
tokens.usage: Tint over a valid drop target in Dock and lists.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on `background`, `popover-background` and `list-background`.

tokens.name: info-background
tokens.usage: Informational badge and Alert. Info meaning only.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `info-background`. Below 4.5:1 on `info-background` in both themes (2.3:1 light, 2.0:1 dark); kept from the source. Prefer outline Tags for status text.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.usage: The one-pixel frame of Input, Select, NumberInput and other editable fields. 1.3:1 (light) and 1.5:1 (dark) on `background`: under 3:1 for control boundaries, as in shadcn. Kept from the source.

tokens.name: link-foreground
tokens.usage: Link text (URLs and email only); distinguished by underline, not hue.

tokens.name: list-active-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the selected list row.

tokens.name: muted-background
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: disabled controls, code spans, placeholders.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary metadata, help text, placeholders and descriptions on `background`. 4.7:1 light, 7.9:1 dark on `background`.

tokens.name: popover-background
tokens.usage: Every anchored surface: Popover, menus, Select, Combobox, DatePicker, Tooltip-like panels.

tokens.name: primary-background
tokens.usage: Primary Button fill, checked Checkbox/Radio/Switch, the one default commit in a decision area.

tokens.name: primary-active-background
tokens.usage: Primary Button while pressed or its popup is open.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring around the focused control. Light value is 2.5:1 on `background`, under the 3:1 floor for focus indicators; the 3px band at 50% adds presence. Kept from the source.

tokens.name: scrollbar-thumb-hover-background
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb on hover or drag.

tokens.name: secondary-background
tokens.usage: Default (secondary) Button fill and neutral chips.

tokens.name: selection-background
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight in inputs, editors and selectable text.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-background
tokens.usage: Emphasised sidebar element (e.g. an avatar block).

tokens.name: success-background
tokens.usage: Success badge, positive status. Success meaning only.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `success-background`. Below 4.5:1 on `success-background` in both themes (2.2:1 light, 1.9:1 dark); kept from the source. Prefer outline Tags for status text.

tokens.name: table-active-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the selected table row.

tokens.name: table-head-foreground
tokens.usage: Table header labels. Dark value reaches only about 2.3:1 on `table-head-background`; kept from the source.

tokens.name: status_bar-background
tokens.usage: StatusBar at the bottom of a window.

tokens.name: warning-background
tokens.usage: Warning badge and caution states. Warning meaning only.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-background`. Below 4.5:1 on `warning-background` in both themes (1.8:1 light, 1.9:1 dark); kept from the source. Prefer outline Tags for status text.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modal Dialog and Sheet.

tokens.name: window-border
tokens.usage: The outer border of a client-decorated window.

tokens.name: base-red
tokens.usage: Base red for data, tags and terminal-like content.

tokens.name: base-red-light
tokens.usage: Lighter red: tag backgrounds and subtle data marks.

tokens.name: base-green
tokens.usage: Base green for data, tags and terminal-like content.

tokens.name: base-green-light
tokens.usage: Lighter green: tag backgrounds and subtle data marks.

tokens.name: base-blue
tokens.usage: Base blue for data, tags and terminal-like content.

tokens.name: base-blue-light
tokens.usage: Lighter blue: tag backgrounds and subtle data marks.

tokens.name: base-yellow
tokens.usage: Base yellow for data, tags and terminal-like content.

tokens.name: base-yellow-light
tokens.usage: Lighter yellow: tag backgrounds and subtle data marks.

tokens.name: base-magenta
tokens.usage: Base magenta for data, tags and terminal-like content.

tokens.name: base-magenta-light
tokens.usage: Lighter magenta: tag backgrounds and subtle data marks.

tokens.name: base-cyan
tokens.usage: Base cyan for data, tags and terminal-like content.

tokens.name: base-cyan-light
tokens.usage: Lighter cyan: tag backgrounds and subtle data marks.

tokens.name: description_list_label-background
tokens.usage: Label cell fill of a bordered DescriptionList.

tokens.name: editor-foreground
tokens.usage: Code text in the editor on `editor-background`.

tokens.name: editor-created
tokens.usage: Added lines in the gutter. Below 4.5:1 on `editor-background` (4.4:1 in dark); kept from the source theme.

tokens.name: editor-hint
tokens.usage: Inline hints (types, parameter names). Below 4.5:1 on `editor-background` (3.8:1 in light); kept from the source theme.

tokens.name: editor-modified
tokens.usage: Modified lines in the gutter. Below 4.5:1 on `editor-background` (4.4:1 in light); kept from the source theme.

tokens.name: editor-warning
tokens.usage: Diagnostic warnings. The dark theme defines no value; it inherits the light one here. Below 4.5:1 on `editor-background` (2.7:1 in light); kept from the source theme.

tokens.name: syntax-attribute
tokens.usage: Syntax highlight: `attribute` captures. Below 4.5:1 on `editor-background` (4.2:1 in light); kept from the source theme.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Syntax highlight: `comment` captures. Below 4.5:1 on `editor-background` (3.8:1 in light); kept from the source theme.

tokens.name: syntax-comment-doc
tokens.usage: Syntax highlight: `comment.doc` captures. Below 4.5:1 on `editor-background` (3.8:1 in light); kept from the source theme.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", "JetBrains Mono", monospace

styles.name: text-xl
styles.usage: Largest step of the scale: a window or page title identifying the current object.

styles.name: text-lg
styles.usage: Section titles and large-size control labels.

styles.name: text-md
styles.usage: Body text. The theme `font_size`, which is also 1rem for the whole window.
styles.sample: The document will be moved to Trash.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Control labels, menu items, table cells, descriptions: the workhorse of medium-density UI.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Badges, Kbd, captions, status bar text, compact (small) controls.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog title (`text_base` semibold). Notification and Alert titles use the same weight at 14px.

styles.name: mono-md
styles.usage: Code editor, identifiers, shortcuts and aligned numeric data. The theme `mono_font_size`.

spacing.note: Relationships, not literals: in code use rem helpers (`gap_2`, `p_4`) or `spacing_tokens()`.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Optical correction: icon baseline, compact separator.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Parts of one control: menu icon and label, title and description; small Button gap.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Closely related controls: Button icon and label, dialog actions.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: One content group: notification columns, compact form rows.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Separate groups in one section: panel padding, form groups.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Separate sections: major blocks in a page or inspector.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Major region boundary: empty-state breathing room, page bands.

radius.note: Every tier derives from the theme `radius` (6px): a theme that sets it to 0 squares the whole system, pills included.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square edges: window content, table cells, docked panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The theme `radius`: Buttons, Inputs, menus, popovers, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The theme `radius_lg`: Dialog, Notification, Sheet, large surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: `radius_full()`: Switch, Avatar, pills. Squares off when `radius` is 0.

shadow.note: Elevation explains stacking, not importance. The window surface is flat.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Controls that sit on a surface: Button outline, Switch thumb, Slider thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Anchored popups: Popover, menus, Select, Tooltip.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Topmost decision layer: Dialog, Notification, Sheet.
